use.flag: Build the zed-extension CLI for managing extensions
Build the GPUI UI inspector, which shows the element tree, layout and styles of Zed's own interface at run time
Use mimalloc as the global memory allocator for improved performance
Enable Neovim integration for full vim compatibility via RPC
Build and install zed-remote-server, the daemon that backs Zed's SSH remote editing. Without it the client downloads its own copy from zed.dev onto the remote host at run time
Enable screen capture support for collaboration sessions
Enable Tracy profiler integration for performance analysis

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter. This is the source-compiled version of upstream's tagged releases (stable and preview), unpatched. For the pre-built binary package, use app-editors/zed-bin instead; for the snapshot carrying this overlay's Claude integration, app-editors/zeo.
